samples.title: Record samples
samples.intro: You'll be shown one prompt at a time. Hold the dictation key, speak, and release. Nothing is typed and nothing is sent anywhere: the recordings stay on this Mac until you choose to share them.
samples.speaker_hint: The microphone and this Mac are recorded with every sample, so there is no need to add them here.
samples.hold: Hold the dictation key and speak.
samples.said_hint: Write the words as you spoke them, such as “nine thirty”, not “9:30”. Change this only if you said something different.
samples.nothing_said: Recorded. Nothing needs to be written for this one.
samples.done: That's all of them. Save the set to finish.
samples.heard: A model on this Mac heard:
microphone.heading: Microphone
microphone.system_default_what: Whatever macOS is set to use.
microphone.not_connected: Not connected. The system default is used until it is.
samples.replace_hint: Hold the key to record it again and replace it.
samples.difference: Compared with the words on screen:
samples.difference_hint: Numbers written as figures, like 9:30, show as differences too.
samples.no_difference: The model heard exactly the words on screen.
samples.record_over: Not right? Hold the key again to record over it.
status.ready_untested: The speech model is loaded. It has not been tested with your language yet, so mistakes are more likely.
